HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Panch- mahabhoot.
   B. Apply the teaching of Panch- mahabhoot with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Panch- mahabhoot has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str.
   D. Use Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.

   C. Hiding stolen items
